page_title: LAZ 5-1 MON | Lazio v Monza 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is caught offside!
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.

90+2' Good clearance! Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players. Lazio force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+1' Lazio keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
90+1' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' 5 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Rovella slips a clever pass through to Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the roof of the net. 5:1.
86' 4 - 1 Goal! Ivan Provedel gets a hand on the penalty from Stefano Sensi (Monza), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
85' Stefano Sensi (Monza) is going to take the penalty!
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kacper Urbanski walks off the pitch to be replaced by Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza).
85' Patrick Ciurria will be replaced by Stefano Sensi (Monza).
85' The Monza players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

84' Play continues despite the shouts by some Monza players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
83' Surely that's handball by one of the Lazio players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
79' Salvatore Bocchetti has decided to make a change. Samuele Vignato (Monza) replaces Dany Mota.
79' Kevin Zeroli (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessandro Bianco.
77' 4 - 0 What a goal! Tijjani Noslin plays it to Pedro (Lazio), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Semuel Pizzignacco into the bottom right corner. 4:0.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) will replace Taty Castellanos.
76' Here is a change. Mattia Zaccagni is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Loum Tchaouna (Lazio).
74' Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio).
71' Adam Marusic (Lazio) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) replaces Nuno Tavares.
65' Gustav Isaksen goes off the pitch and Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) comes on.
62' 3 - 0 Goal! Mattia Zaccagni plays a simple square pass into the feet of Taty Castellanos (Lazio) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
60' Substitution. Kacper Urbanski (Monza) did his best and is replaced by Gaetano Castrovilli.
60' Substitution. Stefano Sensi receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Patrick Ciurria (Monza) walks off.

57' 2 - 0 Goal! Taty Castellanos plays in Pedro (Lazio), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the left side of the net! Great finish - 2:0.

54' What a chance that is! Tomas Palacios (Monza) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the right post.
53' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
53' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio). The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
51' Armando Izzo (Monza) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Aureliano signals a set piece.
50' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.

48' Pedro (Lazio) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Semuel Pizzignacco pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
47' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
47' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
46' The whistle blows and Gianluca Aureliano starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Pedro Pereira (Monza) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
45' Lazio are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
44' Pedro (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for an infringement.
43' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
41' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
39' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
38' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes the corner but it's cleared.
38' Adam Marusic (Lazio) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and Lazio manage to earn a corner.
35' Marco Baroni is forced to make a change. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is unable to continue due to injury, Pedro comes on.
34' Flag up against Taty Castellanos (Lazio). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
33' It will be a substitution. Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is ready to enter the pitch as Kevin Martins walks off.
31' 1 - 0 Adam Marusic (Lazio) shows that he can easily score goals using his head after netting another fantastic header!
30' Semuel Pizzignacco is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Ivan Provedel (Lazio). Easy save!
28' Gianluca Aureliano blows his whistle for a foul after Pedro Pereira (Monza) hacks down one of his opponents. Lazio get a free kick.
26' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Nuno Tavares, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
26' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
25' A cross by Nuno Tavares (Lazio) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
23' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
21' Lazio quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

21' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
20' The resulting corner from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is cleared by the defence.
20' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
18' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
16' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) latches onto a lofted pass from Gustav Isaksen on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
13' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
12' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
12' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

11' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Semuel Pizzignacco has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. Lazio earn a corner.
9' Silvere Ganvoula (Monza) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
7' A pass from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is intercepted by Semuel Pizzignacco and the move breaks down.
4' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Monza will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Aureliano will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
